description: This PHP source file defines the BankTransfer class, which models the bank transfer payment method in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes logic for determining the availability of the payment method based on customer address, subscription status, and geographic zones, and provides the payment method data to the system.

classes.name: BankTransfer
classes.description: Represents the bank transfer payment extension, providing method availability logic based on configuration, customer address, and geographic zones.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Determines if the bank transfer payment method is available for the given address and returns relevant method data, including code, display name, options, and sort order.
